description: Defines the NameConstraints class for parsing and testing certificate name constraints as per RFC 5280, including methods for checking permitted DNS names, directory names, IP addresses, and handling name constraints in certificates.

classes.name: net::NameConstraints
classes.description: Handles parsing and validation of certificate name constraints, including permitted and excluded subtrees, and checks for DNS names, directory names, and IP addresses.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a NameConstraints object by parsing DER-encoded extension value.

methods.name: IsPermittedCert
methods.description: Checks if a certificate complies with the name constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDNSName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name is permitted under the constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDirectoryName
methods.description: Checks if a directory name is permitted.

methods.name: IsPermittedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is permitted.
